meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 NanoClaw 添加新通道或修改行为
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在定制 NanoClaw 的行为或集成新通道。
copy.tagline_en: Add new channels or modify NanoClaw behavior
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are customizing NanoClaw's behavior or integrating new channels.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先提问弄清你要改什么,再运行对应安装技能(如 /add-telegram)或改配置,添加渠道、调整触发词、加集成,并告诉你如何验证。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 加渠道(Telegram、Slack、邮件等)、改触发词、添加集成或做其他自定义时触发。它会先问问题确认需求。

say.text: 把 Telegram 加为输入渠道
say.note: 会运行 /add-telegram 并询问设置。

say.text: 改一下触发词,群里发“接单”才唤醒代理人
say.note: 会更新 wirings 的触发规则。

say.text: 给财务组接入 Gmail 工具

howto.what_en: After install, Claude becomes a NanoClaw customizer: asks questions, runs install skills (e.g. /add-telegram) or edits configs to add channels, change triggers, add integrations, adjust behavior, and explains verification.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email, etc.), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make other customizations. It asks questions first to clarify.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel.
say_en.note: It runs /add-telegram and asks about your setup.

say_en.text: Change the trigger so a group only wakes the agent on “accept order”.
say_en.note: It updates the wiring trigger rules.

say_en.text: Add Gmail access to the finance agent group.
